text:
alex: Heads-up: ap-south1 ephemeral nodes showing repeated NVMe IOPS spikes since 10:05 UTC. GPU attach queue climbed and a few pods entered Pending due to ephemeral-io backoffs.

maria: saw it too. quick metrics: nvme_iops peaking ~170k (normally ~55k), write_amp ~2.1x, attach latency median +85s.

jun: any janitor/cleaner churn? those can amplify writes when cache grows.

alex: node logs snapshot:```
[2026-03-23T10:06:12Z] kvcache: growth event +900MB (model=longchat-v2)
[2026-03-23T10:06:12Z] janitor: launch concurrency=3 cohort=hot
[2026-03-23T10:06:13Z] nvme: iosubmit backlog -> iops=168k
[2026-03-23T10:06:14Z] gpu-attach: attach-backoff start reason=ephemeral-io
```

priya: opsbot alerted at 10:07: "IOPS_SPIKE ap-south1". Runbook suggests lowering janitor concurrency and applying kvcache soft-limits.

opsbot: @channel detected IOPS_SPIKE on ap-south1-ephemeral. Recommend: 1) set kvcache.soft_limit=1.2G for hot cohort, 2) set janitor.max_concurrency=1, 3) pause non-critical backfills.

sam: proposing immediate mitigations. I'll roll soft-limit to 1.2G on the 8 affected nodes and reduce janitor concurrency. Command used: `parallel-ssh -h hot-nodes "sudo /usr/local/bin/set-kvcache --soft=1.2G && sudo /usr/local/bin/janitorctl concurrency 1"`

maria: sounds good. can you also label nodes to stop scheduled backfills? `kubectl label node <node> ephemeral-backfill=paused`

sam: doing that now. ETA 2m.

(alex edits) alex: note correlation with longchat-v2 session counts — requests with >32k tokens cause big prefix writes.

jun: long-term idea: introduce model-aware cache caps + incremental write coalescing (batch small writes into one large write to reduce write amplification). Also add a detector for sudden cache growth per-model.

priya: cost/ops tradeoff: we can buy more Dedicated capacity in ap-south1 to reduce attach churn (~$7.5k/month) OR invest in heuristic work (engineer weeks). Recommend trace first before procurement.

maria: 4m after mitigation: nvme_iops down to ~1.15x baseline, attach backlog from 39 -> 5. Progressing.

sam: collecting 6h perf trace and full node-level iostat, smartctl dumps. I'll push to /tmp/ap-south1-traces and link.

jun: I'll spin up a local canary that replays longchat-v2 prompts to reproduce, then test coalescing patch.

priya: filing follow-ups: [1] 6h trace + upload (sam), [2] eviction heuristic proposal + design doc (jun), [3] finance/product capacity analysis (maria & product), [4] update runbook with kvcache throttles and paging thresholds (ops).

alex: small alert tuning: lower SRE pages by only paging if attach_backlog > 60 for 10m to avoid noise.

maria: agreed. also add a metric for per-model cache delta over 5m windows.

sam: all mitigations applied, monitoring for 30m. Will revert labels/backfills when stable.

priya: thanks team. if this reoccurs we escalate to capacity purchase convo, but for now keep on-watch and prioritize the eviction heuristic ticket. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Monitoring watch initiated for 12h. Will escalate if attach_backlog >= 60 for 10m or nvme_iops >= 2x baseline for 15m."
